diagnosis: The analysis shows that the program has problems with sign handling when calculating determinants. Specifically, when a matrix has a particular structure (such as upper triangular or lower triangular), errors in symbolic computation cause the sign of the result to differ from what is expected. In addition, the sign change relationship test showed that the sign of the determinant did not change correctly after row interchanges. The issues are mainly concentrated in DeterComp The symbolic computation part of the method, especially Section 41 The logic for handling symbols in rows. The fix should focus on adjusting the sign calculation to ensure that the sign is correct.
